title: API docs
intro: Public JSON for agents, scripts, and small integrations. No account or API key needed.
nowDescription: The same activities shown on my /now page, returned as structured JSON. Updates appear after the site deploys.
language: English is the default. Add ?lang=zh for Chinese or ?lang=en for English. No other query parameters are supported.
exampleNote: This example shows one event. The actual response includes every event, including paused and finished activities.
url: The human-readable /now page in the requested language. Resolve relative links in details against this URL.
languageField: The language of title and details: en or zh.
updatedAt: When the content was last edited, in ISO 8601 format. This is not the request time.
detailsFormat: Always markdown. Details are source text, without rendered HTML.
events: All activities. Each has id, title, status, startedAt, updatedAt, finishedAt, and details.
id: Stable activity identifier for matching activities between requests.
status: active: building now; recurring: ongoing activity; paused: on hold; finished: completed.
dates: Event dates use ISO 8601 with a timezone offset when available. Missing dates are null. Preserve the supplied timezone.
agentIntro: Fetch the JSON, then filter events by status. For example, this lists the activities I am actively building:
http: GET returns JSON. HEAD returns the same response headers without a body. OPTIONS is supported for browser requests. Cross-origin reads are allowed. Responses may be cached for up to 60 seconds; polling once a minute is plenty.
errors: Invalid query parameters return 400 with a JSON error. Unsupported methods return 405 with an Allow header. This endpoint is read-only.
